provisional: No species-validation or adoption claim; current instrument/baseline screen

size_match.rule: per candidate on its own seeds: the first season at which the median over seeds of the per-seed median DBH of the live measured trees (cli/allometry.ts) reaches dbh; a match at the first season counts and is flagged; none by the last, or outside dump_seasons: unmatched, every Level 1 term costs MISSING_PENALTY and the candidate is flagged

correlation.rule: Pearson r between every two descriptors over the real trees, pairwise complete, on the values detrended to size_match.dbh by each descriptor's registered slope (as the targets are); level1.correlation

clusters.rule: scipy linkage(method) on the condensed 1 − |r|, fcluster at distance 1 − cut_r; canonical order: members sorted, clusters by their first member. np.random.default_rng(held_out_seed).choice(len(list), len(list), replace=False) is the draw order; clusters are taken whole in that order until the held-out descriptors number >= round(n/3)
clusters.straddling_note: pairs at |r| >= cut_r across clusters (average linkage does not separate them) that the draw left on both sides of the fitted/held-out line; within a cluster none can straddle

held_out_rule: whole clusters to a third (`clusters`); redrawn once in v3, for independence (the user, 2026-11-04), never again
held_out_note: never written by the fit (the user, 2026-11-04); only level1_gate.py computes and writes them

weights.rule: w_k = 1 / Σ_j |r_kj| over all the descriptors, self included (|r_kk| = 1), every |r| below r_crit set to 0 first; the fitted descriptors' w_k weigh their location terms
weights.r_crit_rule: two-sided critical value of Pearson's r at n = the real trees: t / sqrt(t² + n − 2), t the (1 − alpha/2) quantile of Student's t on n − 2

real_rule: each tree the median over its repeats (tolerance.median_of; NaN under 3); OLS on ln measured DBH: slope, residual SD (df n − 2, 95% CI), the median of y − slope (ln d − ln dbh). noise_rms is the repeat floor (phase1-tolerances.json); the gate reads the raw SD
sim_rule: the stand's live measured trees at the matched season: coarsen.coarsen(inflated=True) at d_min_m, describe(), detrended with the registered slope on cylinders.dbh of the uncoarsened tree; trees outside real_dbh_range_m are counted and reported, never excluded; fine values never enter the loss

loss.level0: fit.contributions(load_spec(species, level=0)): Level 0's scored traits and death penalties at their Level 0 weights
loss.terms: Level 0's contributions less the level0_reported traits (at level0_band where given) + Σ over fitted k of location_weights[k] · (z_k² + spread_penalty(s_k))
loss.z: (median of the detrended simulated trees − real median) / real SD
loss.s: ln(simulated SD (ddof 1) / real SD) / ln 2; computed and reported per descriptor, never scored
loss.missing: w_k · missing_penalty in place of w_k · z_k²: a descriptor with fewer than min_trees finite trees, or every descriptor of an unmatched candidate
loss.seeds_rule: v3's 10, kept by the user for pilots v3 and v4, not re-decided; the noise check (level1_noise_v4.py: the hand on the three 10-seed draws) is reported only
loss.spread_penalty: level1.spread_penalty: (ln(min(1, r / spread_floor)) / ln 2)², r = simulated SD / real SD = 2^s; 0 at r >= spread_floor; w_k · missing_penalty where s cannot be read (fewer than min_trees finite trees, a zero SD, unmatched)
loss.level0_reported_rule: reported, not scored, in the Level 1 loss (fit_level1.level1_spec); summary() writes the terms they would add at their Level 0 weights under `reported`; they stay in the Level 0 gate
loss.level0_band_rule: the band of a scored Level 0 trait in the Level 1 loss only (fit_level1.level1_spec); Level 0's targets file, fit and gate keep their own

gate.held_out: a seed passes when every held-out descriptor's |z| <= z, on the median of that seed's live measured trees, detrended; the species on >= pass_seeds
gate.spread: every descriptor's simulated SD, fitted and held out (level1.spread_names), over all the gate's trees within ×2 of the real SD
gate.shape_flag: gallery.shape_flag clear, the hand = the Level 0 fit with the targets file's [form]
gate.size_match: over the gate's seeds, by the size_match rule

control.rule: 20 pseudo-seeds of 4 real trees (without replacement within a seed), judged by the gate's held-out and spread rules (spread on every descriptor); then the pass count over `sets` such draws. In sample. Demol's trees as pseudo-seeds on the tier A held-out descriptors: the out-of-sample check
